title: Getting a cornet from a neighbor boy at ten or eleven
summary: A neighbor boy let him blow his trumpet, the boy's father taught him the scale, and he got a cornet at about ten or eleven.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: Were you raised right in the city? Yeah. Of Louisville, right in the city?
Right in Louisville. Can you tell me how you got interested in wanting to learn to play music yourself?

Well, I was a boy of just about my age, lived next door to me, had a trumpet, and we used to play together, you know, kids together. Yeah. And he used to let me blow on the horn. So that's how I got started on the... Blowing on his horn.
And his father, had been a clarinet, used to play clarinet in the band. And he taught me the scale, and so I finally got a hold of the cornet.
About how old were you when you started drawing? Well, I was young, very young then, I guess.
I must have been... Oh... I must have been around... Ten, ten, eleven years old. Yeah. Really young.
That was the first instrument you ever had in your hands? Yeah, yeah.

Yeah, yeah. The cornet. The cornet or trumpet? A cornet. The cornet. And I started from that. Then the kid, he and I used to practice together. Eventually I got started over in the church. They had a school band over at the church that I attended. They had a band over there, and went to Catholic school, St. Augustine School. They had a band over there, and one of the fellas that played in there worked for the priest. Yes. Oh, man, he was in the band, and so he had him to show me, help me along with the trumpet.
